Subject: Post-call recap + environment options for the POC (success criteria attached)

Hi Lena / Markus —

Great conversation this morning — thanks for the time and for walking through the ML/infra constraints. Per our discussion, I wanted to recap the recommended trial approaches, a draft set of success criteria, and the immediate asks to keep the PoC on a 3-week cadence. I attached a short workbook (POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx) with the evaluation matrix and a place for you to enter sample dataset details.

Environment options (trade-offs):
- Hosted Redwood API (fastest to spin up): zero infra on your side, lowest setup time. Good for functional validation and prompt engineering. Not ideal if you need strict network isolation or PHI controls.
- Dedicated sandbox (reserved GPU pool in our cloud): predictable performance and stronger isolation. Requires commitment window (typically 30 days minimum) and a short procurement step. Recommended if you want throughput/latency parity with production.
- VPC trial (private control plane + in-VPC inference nodes): supports stricter compliance (customer VPC, KMS integration, network egress control). Longer lead time (we estimate 2–3 weeks for initial infra and network setup), but best match if you must keep PHI inside your VPC.

Draft success criteria (please review in the workbook):
- Latency: p95 generation latency < 350ms for 1K token streams in the dedicated config (or equivalent hosted baseline).
- Accuracy: model must match or exceed current heuristic on benchmark dataset (we'll co-run the eval harness).
- Throughput: sustain 50 concurrent inference sessions at target latency.
- Cost target: estimated unit cost < $0.02 per 1K tokens for the steady-state profile (we can refine once you share token distribution).

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Confirm preferred environment (Hosted / Dedicated / VPC) — this will determine timeline and whether we need a purchase order.
2) Provide a point of contact for procurement and an initial sample dataset (10k–50k docs) or a data schema.
3) If VPC, share network contacts and firewall window availability (we'll need an allowed egress to our provisioning endpoints).
4) Let us know any hard compliance gates (SOC2, HIPAA, region-specific requirements).

Proposed timeline (if VPC chosen):
- Week 0: PO / SOW and network kickoff
- Week 1–2: infra provisioning and baseline model onboarding
- Week 3: run evaluation and review results; decision point after demo

I can coordinate the kickoff — copying a short slate of internal owners in a follow-up.

Attachments: POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx

Best,
Camila Reyes
